Extract Probes Overlapping Input BED Region(s)

Source: R/module_probeset.R
ExtractProbesByBeds.Rd

Unified implementation for probe extraction from either in-memory BED coordinates (bed) or BED file input (bedFile). This harmonizes legacy ExtractProbesByBeds() and ExtractProbesByBeds2() behavior.

Usage

ExtractProbesByBeds(
  bed = NULL,
  bedFile = NULL,
  probes.all = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  version = "HG19",
  verbose = FALSE,
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

bed

Character vector of BED regions (chr:start-end) or a 3-column BED-like data frame. Used when bedFile is NULL.

bedFile

Optional BED file path. When provided, this mode is used.

probes.all

Optional annotation table. If NULL, loads inst/extdata/anno.uniq_harmonized.liftover.rds.

assay

Optional assay filter.

version

Genome build label ("HG19" or "HG38") used to select annotation columns.

verbose

Logical passed to bedr helpers.

file

Optional output path for writing tab-delimited results.

Value

Data frame of matched probes. In bedFile mode, returns region-aware output compatible with legacy ExtractProbesByBeds2().
